ThingDef.label: Ancient shield harmonic prism
ThingDef.description: An inert precursor calibration prism recovered from a mature shield system. Its field vanes no longer project a usable barrier, and archaeological specimens are usually physically damaged, but the surviving phase geometry preserves a reference for Ancient shield harmonics. It must be analyzed at a research bench before the colony can attempt to reconstruct the high-energy emitter architecture.

li.activateDescString: Assign a researcher to map the surviving phase geometry in this recovered precursor shield-calibration prism.
li.completedLetter: The recovered prism's nested phase relationships and field-return geometry have been mapped. The original remains inert, but the colony now has a genuine Ancient reference from which high-energy shield harmonics can be investigated.
